description: Publishers a deployed app shows (local development shows every validly signed release). Each entry vouches for one public key: never put a private key here. pubkey: 64 hex characters, from `pnpm cli pubkey --key <file>`. roles: "models" (listed in the catalog) and/or "router" (may provide the System 1 router). approvedBy: who vouches; weXare today, community curators later. A deployment can use another file with WEXARE_PUBLISHERS.
